title: cyperus chersinus var. angularis
intro: Cyperus chersinus var. angularis, commonly known as the Angular Sedge, is a type of plant species within the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use as a natural remedy to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues and fever. The therapeutic actions of Angular Sedge are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents found in Angular Sedge include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, although further research is needed to fully understand its pharmacological profile.
